title: sunasty_color_math: Zero-dependency sRGB, OKLCH, and WCAG 2.1 Color Conversions for Dart and Flutter
description: Zero-dependency algorithmic Dart package for IEC 61966-2-1 sRGB gamma linearization, Oklab/OKLCH perceptual transformations, and WCAG 2.1 accessibility contrast calculation. Developed for Flutter and WebAssembly client-side applications as part of the Sunasty web utility suite.
